pages.text: $(bold)Water washes Sweaty Feet; medicinal water cures fungus.$()$(br2)Way one: $(bold)soak barefoot in water$() — with Sweaty Feet, wade into any water and the soak timer counts up by level (wearing boots while in water just reminds you to take them off).$(br2)Way two: sit on a stool, take off your boots, and $(bold)right-click an adjacent water-filled basin with an empty hand$().

When done: Sweaty Feet (and fungus, if medicinal) is cured, and the basin water turns $(bold)dirty$() — scoop it up with a bucket for "X's dirty foot-washing water".$(br2)$(bold)Degrading$(): after taking boots off, Sweaty Feet drops one level every configured interval down to level 1, then stays — $(bold)only washing fully clears it$().$(br2)For the basin's check order and soak progress details, see "Mechanics → Basin Soak Checks".
